description.en: Say what you do, talk about jobs from the office to the jua kali yard, and handle hours, pay and job interviews.
description.so: Sheeg shaqada aad qabato, ka hadal shaqooyinka laga bilaabo xafiiska ilaa goobaha jua kali, oo wax ka qabo saacadaha, mushaharka iyo wareysiyada shaqada.

body.en: Kufanya kazi means 'to work' (lit. to do work). Ask Unafanya kazi gani? (what work?) or Unafanya kazi wapi? (where?). Answer with Mimi ni + job: Mimi ni mwalimu. In everyday speech Kenyans drop the ni- of the present tense: Nafanya kazi tao, Naanza saa mbili.
body.so: Kufanya kazi waxay ka dhigan tahay 'shaqayn' (macnaha: shaqo qabasho). Weydii Unafanya kazi gani? (shaqo noocee ah?) ama Unafanya kazi wapi? (xaggee?). Ku jawaab Mimi ni + shaqada: Mimi ni mwalimu. Hadalka maalinlaha ah, Kenyaanku waxay iska dhaafaan ni- ee waqtiga joogtada: Nafanya kazi tao, Naanza saa mbili.

examples.sw: Mimi ni muuguzi. Nafanya kazi hospitalini.
examples.en: I'm a nurse. I work at a hospital.
examples.so: Kalkaaliso caafimaad baan ahay. Isbitaal ayaan ka shaqeeyaa.

body.en: Jua kali means 'fierce sun'. It names Kenya's informal sector: welders, mechanics, carpenters and metalworkers who work in open yards such as Kamukunji in Nairobi. Any skilled tradesman is a fundi: fundi wa magari (mechanic), fundi wa simu (phone repairer), fundi wa nguo (tailor), fundi wa mabomba (plumber).
body.so: Jua kali macnaheedu waa 'qorrax kulul'. Waa magaca qaybta shaqada aan rasmiga ahayn ee Kenya: alxamiyayaal, makaanikyo, nijaarro iyo kuwa birta ka shaqeeya oo ku shaqeeya goobo bannaan sida Kamukunji ee Nairobi. Farsamayaqaan kasta waa fundi: fundi wa magari (makaanik), fundi wa simu (dayactire taleefan), fundi wa nguo (harqaanle), fundi wa mabomba (tuubbiste).

examples.en: I've taken my phone to the repairer.

body.en: Swahili time starts counting at 6 a.m. and 6 p.m. So saa mbili asubuhi is 8 a.m. and saa kumi na moja jioni is 5 p.m. A normal office day runs from saa mbili to saa kumi na moja. Being late is Nimechelewa; a shift is zamu.
body.so: Waqtiga Sawaaxiligu wuxuu tirinta ka bilaabaa 6-da subaxnimo iyo 6-da fiidnimo. Sidaas darteed saa mbili asubuhi waa 8-da subaxnimo, saa kumi na moja jioni waa 5-ta galabnimo. Maalin xafiis oo caadi ah waxay socotaa saa mbili ilaa saa kumi na moja. Daahitaanku waa Nimechelewa; nobadda shaqaduna waa zamu.

examples.sw: Natoka kazini saa kumi na moja jioni.

body.en: Bosi is the everyday word for your boss, mwajiri is the formal word for an employer, and young Nairobians say mdosi. A watchman is mlinzi, but most Kenyans say askari, and young people say watchie. Use bosi and mwajiri at work; keep the Sheng for friends.
body.so: Bosi waa erayga maalinlaha ah ee madaxaaga shaqada, mwajiri waa erayga rasmiga ah ee shaqo-bixiyaha, dhallinyarada Nairobina waxay yiraahdaan mdosi. Waardiyuhu waa mlinzi, laakiin Kenyaanka badankood waxay yiraahdaan askari, dhallinyaraduna watchie. Shaqada ku isticmaal bosi iyo mwajiri; Sheng-ga u daa saaxiibbada.

examples.en: My boss is a bit strict.
examples.so: Madaxayga shaqadu wax yar buu adag yahay.

note.en: Also a respectful title: Mwalimu Otieno.
note.so: Sidoo kale waa magac sharafeed: Mwalimu Otieno.

note.en: fundi wa magari = mechanic, fundi wa simu = phone repairer, fundi wa nguo = tailor.
note.so: fundi wa magari = makaanik, fundi wa simu = dayactire taleefan, fundi wa nguo = harqaanle.

note.en: Most Kenyans call a watchman askari, and young people say watchie. Askari can also mean a police officer or a soldier.
note.so: Kenyaanka badankood waardiyaha waxay ugu yeeraan askari, dhallinyaraduna waxay yiraahdaan watchie. Askari sidoo kale waxay noqon kartaa boolis ama askari ciidan.
Kenyaan badan ayaa sidoo kale yiraahda nesi.

note.en: Mimi ni + job: Mimi ni mwalimu, Mimi ni karani.
note.so: Mimi ni + shaqada: Mimi ni mwalimu, Mimi ni karani.

note.en: Westlands is a business district of Nairobi. Nafanya is the everyday short form of ninafanya.
note.so: Westlands waa xaafad ganacsi oo Nairobi ah. Nafanya waa qaabka gaaban ee maalinlaha ah ee ninafanya.

note.en: kazi + -ni = at work. Niko kazini = I'm at work.
note.so: kazi + -ni = shaqada. Niko kazini = shaqada ayaan joogaa.

note.en: Swahili time: saa mbili (hour two) = 8 a.m.
note.so: Waqtiga Sawaaxiliga: saa mbili (saacadda labaad) = 8-da subaxnimo.

note.en: zamu ya usiku = night shift. Many Kenyans just say shift: Niko shift ya usiku.
note.so: zamu ya usiku = nobadda habeenka. Kenyaan badan waxay si fudud u yiraahdaan shift: Niko shift ya usiku.
Niko likizo = fasax baan ku jiraa.

note.en: Literally 'fierce sun': craftsmen who work outdoors, such as welders, mechanics and furniture makers. A proud Kenyan term.
note.so: Macnaha erayga waa 'qorrax kulul': farsamayaqaannada bannaanka ka shaqeeya, sida alxamiyayaasha, makaanikyada iyo kuwa sameeya alaabta guryaha. Waa eray Kenyaanku ku faanaan.

note.en: Also the casual worker himself. Plural: vibarua.
note.so: Sidoo kale waa qofka shaqadaas qabta. Wadarta: vibarua.

items.en: We get paid at the end of the month
items.so: Mushaharka waxaa nala siiyaa dhammaadka bisha

note.en: Kenyan offices often just say interview. Usaili is the word used in job adverts.
note.so: Xafiisyada Kenya badanaa waxay si fudud u yiraahdaan interview. Usaili waa erayga ku qoran xayeysiinta shaqada.

note.en: Said 'si-vi'. The formal Swahili word is wasifu.
note.so: Waxaa loogu dhawaaqaa 'si-vi'. Erayga rasmiga ah ee Sawaaxiliga waa wasifu.

items.so: Waxaan leeyahay khibrad saddex sano ah

note.en: Also used for any rich, important person.
note.so: Sidoo kale waxaa loogu yeeraa qof kasta oo hodan ah oo muhiim ah.

note.en: A hard worker is a mchapakazi, a popular Kenyan compliment.
note.so: Qofka si adag u shaqeeya waa mchapakazi, waana amaan caan ka ah Kenya.

items.en: A job is a job (no work is shameful)

meaning.en: My mother is a teacher. She teaches at a primary school.
meaning.so: Hooyaday waa macallimad. Waxay wax ka dhigtaa dugsi hoose.

explain.en: 'My car has broken down.' – 'Oh no! Find a fundi (mechanic).'
explain.so: 'Gaarigaygu wuu xumaaday.' – 'Waan ka xumahay! Raadi fundi (makaanik).'

lines.sw: Asante, mzee. Mimi ni mfanyakazi mpya hapa. Mimi ni muuguzi.
lines.en: Thank you, sir. I'm a new employee here. I'm a nurse.
lines.so: Mahadsanid, adeer. Waxaan ahay shaqaale cusub oo halkan ah. Kalkaaliso caafimaad baan ahay.

lines.sw: Karibu sana! Bosi yuko ndani, ofisi ya kwanza kulia.
lines.en: You're very welcome! The boss is inside, first office on the right.
lines.so: Aad baad u soo dhowdahay! Madaxu gudaha ayuu joogaa, xafiiska koowaad ee midigta.
Aad iyo aad baad u mahadsantahay, adeer.

explain.en: 'Are you a businessperson?' – 'Yes, I have a shop in Eastleigh.'
explain.so: 'Ma ganacsade baad tahay?' – 'Haa, dukaan baan ku leeyahay Eastleigh.'

meaning.en: At night, the watchman guards our houses.

lines.sw: Mimi ni karani katika kampuni ya simu.
lines.en: I'm a clerk at a phone company.
lines.so: Waxaan karraani ka ahay shirkad taleefan.

lines.en: I work in Westlands. And you?

lines.sw: Mimi ni fundi wa magari. Nafanya kazi Kariobangi.
lines.en: I'm a mechanic. I work in Kariobangi.
lines.so: Anigu makaanik baan ahay. Kariobangi ayaan ka shaqeeyaa.

explain.en: 'What work do you do?' – 'I'm a teacher.' Answer with Mimi ni + your job.
explain.so: 'Maxaad ka shaqaysaa?' – 'Macallin baan ahay.' Ku jawaab Mimi ni + shaqadaada.

explain.en: 'Why are you late?' – 'Sorry, I was stuck in traffic.'
explain.so: 'Maxaad u daahday?' – 'Iga raalli ahaw, ciriiriga gaadiidka ayaan ku jiray.'

meaning.en: I'm on the night shift today, so I'll sleep during the day.
meaning.so: Maanta nobadda habeenka ayaan hayaa, sidaas darteed maalintii ayaan seexan doonaa.

lines.sw: Kamau, siku hizi unafanya kazi wapi?
lines.en: Kamau, where are you working these days?

lines.sw: Nafanya kazi ya jua kali pale Kamukunji. Natengeneza masanduku ya chuma.
lines.en: I do jua kali work at Kamukunji. I make metal boxes.
lines.so: Shaqo jua kali ah ayaan ka qabtaa Kamukunji. Waxaan sameeyaa sanaadiiq bir ah.

lines.en: Do you get a good salary?

lines.sw: Hakuna mshahara. Wateja wananilipa kila siku.
lines.en: There's no salary. Customers pay me every day.
lines.so: Mushahar ma jiro. Macaamiishu maalin kasta ayay lacag i siiyaan.

options.en: At the end of the month

options.so: Macaamiishu maalin kasta ayay lacag siiyaan

explain.en: 'I'm looking for work, but I haven't found any yet.' – 'Don't worry, you'll find some.'
explain.so: 'Shaqo ayaan raadinayaa, laakiin weli ma helin.' – 'Ha welwelin, waad heli doontaa.'

meaning.en: My salary is very small; I'm looking for another job.
meaning.so: Mushaharkaygu aad buu u yar yahay; shaqo kale ayaan raadinayaa.

lines.sw: Karibu, Abdi. Kaa chini. Una uzoefu gani?
lines.en: Welcome, Abdi. Have a seat. What experience do you have?
lines.so: Soo dhawoow, Abdi. Fadhiiso. Khibrad noocee ah ayaad leedahay?

lines.sw: Nina uzoefu wa miaka mitatu kama karani wa benki.
lines.en: I have three years' experience as a bank clerk.
lines.so: Waxaan leeyahay khibrad saddex sano ah oo karraani bangi ah.

lines.en: Good. Have you brought your certificates?
lines.so: Waa fiican tahay. Shahaadooyinkaaga ma keentay?

lines.en: Thank you. We'll call you next week.
lines.so: Mahadsanid. Toddobaadka soo socda ayaan ku soo wici doonnaa.

question.en: How many years of experience does Abdi have?
question.so: Abdi immisa sano oo khibrad ah ayuu leeyahay?

extra.heard: Tuna nafasi ya kazi ya mpishi.
options: Nina uzoefu wa miaka miwili kama mpishi.

explain.en: 'We have a vacancy for a cook.' – 'I have two years' experience as a cook.'
explain.so: 'Boos bannaan oo kariye ah ayaan haynaa.' – 'Waxaan leeyahay laba sano oo khibrad ah oo kariye ahaan.'

prompt.en: I'm looking for a job as a cook

explain.en: 'Where are you, man?' – 'I'm at work, we'll talk later.'
explain.so: 'Xaggee joogtaa, saaxiib?' – 'Shaqada ayaan joogaa, goor dambe ayaan wada hadli doonnaa.'

meaning.en: A job is a job; no work is bad.
meaning.so: Shaqo waa shaqo; ma jirto shaqo xun.
